title: Exact restriction of commutative ring-sheaf scalars on the small pro-etale site
statement: Let $T$ be a scheme and use its small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], with site objects in universe $u+1$ and site morphisms in universe $u$. For commutative ring sheaves $R,S$ valued in $\mathrm{CommRingCat}_{u+1}$ and a morphism $a:R\to S$, define $\operatorname{Res}_a:\operatorname{Mod}(S)\to\operatorname{Mod}(R)$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] to be restriction of scalars [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars] after forgetting commutativity of the coefficient sheaves. Modules and their sections live in universe $u+1$. This is the existing additive functor with the same underlying abelian sheaves and maps and action $r\cdot m=a(r)m$. Its named exactness interface supplies preservation of finite limits and finite colimits for every $a$; it requires no surjectivity, flatness, finiteness, or nonzero-ring assumption.
